facts.fact: Goobjoog reports the Federal Government launched the Justice Sector Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS) in Mogadishu on 9 October 2025, linking the CID, the Office of the Prosecutor, the courts and the prison service in one electronic workflow that officials say replaces the paper-based process.
facts.system: Justice Sector Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS)

systems.system: Justice Sector Integrated Electronic Case Management System (IECMS)
systems.owner: Federal Government of Somalia, with U.S. INL and IDLO support

systems.country_label: Somali Police integrated system, 20 Banadir stations

note: A police data-sharing system linking the judiciary; no court case management system named and operations only expected in 2026.
